name: galaxy-brain
description: The Galaxy Brain desktop Knowledge Workbench.

scripts.test:provider-free: npm run package && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/workflows/v1-provider-free-gate.e2e.ts && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/workflows/production-linked-pdf-status.e2e.ts && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/workflows/provider-free-privacy.e2e.ts
scripts.test:workflow: npm run package && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts && npm run test:workflow:issue-52
scripts.test:workflow:issue-52: for failure in bootstrap synthesis-results-read repository-open workspace-transition discovery-jump-transition; do GALAXY_BRAIN_WDIO_FAILURE="$failure" wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/workflows/issue-52-recoverable-ui-state.e2e.ts || exit $?; done
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:mcdc && npm run check:mcdc && npm run test:docs && npm run docs:check
scripts.prepackage: node -e "if (process.version !== 'v24.19.0') { throw new Error('Galaxy Brain requires Node 24.19.0. Run nvm use before packaging.') }"
